editNote: Accepted: the only reports are informational (variant headings, the earlier printing's source line). The book prints 1,500 gp on p.282, but the book's errata (Spring 2026) says 5th-rank magic wands had the wrong Price and cost 1,400 gp; the record's 1,400 gp is the errata's, and level 11 matches.
